sources_considered.why: Full text of Amazon's February 27, 2026 Form 8-K (SEC filing mirror). Gives the date of the $15bn purchase.
SoftBank's primary announcement with its tranche schedule.
Amazon Q1 2026 10-Q. Returned HTTP 403. Search snippets say only that the $15bn was invested in Q1.

evidence_items.publisher: Amazon.com, Inc. (Form 8-K via Boardroom Alpha SEC mirror)
evidence_items.locator: Item 1.01, final sentence of first paragraph

receipt.public_excerpt: Amazon Sub’s agreement to invest $15.0 billion in OpenAI’s Series C Preferred Stock in connection with OpenAI’s current funding round, which Amazon Sub is obligated to purchase on March 31, 2026, subject to certain closing conditions.

evidence_items.explanation: Amazon's only immediate cash part of the round was due on March 31, 2026, after the post. Its other $35bn was a contingent commitment. Amazon had therefore not funded as of March 3.

metric_scope.metric: scheduled equity investment in OpenAI Series C Preferred Stock

receipt.public_excerpt: Closing of First Tranche April 1, 2026 (planned, Japan time)

evidence_items.explanation: SoftBank's first $10bn tranche was planned for April 1, 2026, after the post. SoftBank had therefore not sent money from this round by March 3.

unresolved_gaps: I found no primary source dating NVIDIA's $30bn payment. The post cites NVIDIA's 10-K saying the deal was still being finalized. I could not confirm whether NVIDIA funded before March 3.
Other financial investors said to be joining the round were not checked individually.
